author_direction: Ithran defeated in C03 reports to Serakh, Serakh alerts Velkar; Velkar grants campaign access to half the imperial fleet; Serakh prepares during city recovery and continental conference; C06 larger war, even if land forces beaten, sea strategic fallback; C07 Portais do Horizonte, C08 integration and Architect mysteries.

military_chain.coordination: Serakh and Varkhess are peer generals. Velkar authorizes joint land/arcane and naval campaign; Varkhess retains fleet operational command, with agreed strategic objective. No invented reassignment of all subordinate commands.

fleet.deployment: 260 hulls strategically allocated, must arrive in staggered groups from separate ports; not all warships and not present in Avarenn automatically
fleet.estimated_land_force: proposed first expedition 4000–9000, reinforcements 12000–24000, subject to transport and available soldiers
fleet.time: foreign ocean crossings not mapped canonically; any 12–20d crossing is hypothetical and cannot fix C06 dates
fleet.blockade: after land defeat, sea operations may target specific straits/ports/trade routes under Varkhess, not instant control of the whole sea

information_and_logistics.defeat_report: Default Ithran defeated as campaign commander, may report himself if able and a tested communications path exists; if killed or captured due to Lucas choices, verified messenger takes result without faking escape.
information_and_logistics.velkar_authorization: Velkar's allocation follows Serakh's report with established transmission/travel and must be narrated; not a current event.
information_and_logistics.preparation: Ships undergo muster, crew contracts, supplies, weather windows, convoy formations and staged loading; some naval assets must already be forward-deployed if expedition is to reach Avarenn by C06 quickly.
information_and_logistics.retarget: News of Continental Conference is not instant. On receiving it, Serakh updates objectives from punitive reconquest to anti-coalition strategic operation.
information_and_logistics.full_fleet: Half allocation does not imply half arrived, or that 260 hulls fight a single battle. Reinforcements may continue during later chapters.
information_and_logistics.sea_retreat: Any withdrawal requires accessible beachhead/harbor and naval escort; no guaranteed Serakh escape. Naval interdiction has gaps and contested ports.

chapter_roadmap.name: O Mundo Além dos Portais

rules: All milestones are forward-looking editorial plans, not canonized events.
No retroactive claim that Ithran ordered prior Vesra attacks.
GÊNESE stays complete and no new conscious lives are created this phase.
Do not give Lucas mind control immunity without earned discovery.
ARGOS 100 passenger capacity is new redesign target only; flight, balance, range, oxygen, passengers, crew, landing tested in-story.
Naira is qualified engineer, Rumo free collaborator not automatically licensed pilot; ASA LIVRE not proved flying.
Tharvek/Elyrien are separate from dwarf engineer and Neris emissaries; travel time/consent in scene.
The conference at AERÚN requires real physically present delegates or approved validated live links.
Serakh naval fallback depends on Varkhess command and actual geographical control; cannot close whole continent sea overnight.
Preserve author choices, no automatic victories, protagonist decisions or survival guarantees; military defeat of Ithran is author's intended campaign destination.
Do not write new episode until the chronology issue is addressed or story continues explicitly in a noncanonical draft.
